description: Implementation of a template class SimpleDistribution for statistical calculations, including methods for accumulation, resetting, and computing statistics, with conditional compilation for float specialization.

classes.name: SimpleDistribution
classes.description: Template class for managing a distribution of samples and calculating statistics.

methods.name: setLimits
methods.description: Sets the min and max limits for the distribution, specialized for float type when USE_SSTATS_FLINT is defined.

methods.name: operator new []
methods.description: Allocates memory for an array of SimpleDistribution objects using zmalloc.

methods.name: operator delete []
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for an array of SimpleDistribution objects using zfree.

methods.name: SimpleDistribution constructor
methods.description: Initializes the distribution with a specified range and allocates memory for the distribution array.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the distribution statistics and limits.

methods.name: accumulate
methods.description: Adds a sample to the distribution, updating min, max, and counts.

methods.name: calculate
methods.description: Computes statistical metrics like mean and standard deviation based on accumulated samples.

methods.name: getStats
methods.description: Returns current statistical summary, recalculating if needed.
